## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X327 in one fascicle is [德清](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E6%B8%85)'s short *bǔyí* 補遺 ("supplement") to his major commentary *[Guān Léngqié jīng jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0343)* (X326). The genre signals an addendum: passages, glosses, or doctrinal observations that Hānshān had developed after the main commentary's completion and that he wished to preserve as a coda rather than to retro-fit into the body of X326.

**Abstract**

Date bracket follows Hānshān's late productive period (post-1606 partial rehabilitation, pre-death 1623), and is presumably very late in that bracket since the *bǔyí* presupposes the completion of [X326](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0343). The work is a coda to X326 and should be read with that commentary; it is one of the smaller pieces in the Hānshān corpus but is a useful witness to the maturation of his *Laṅkāvatāra* exegesis in the years immediately preceding his death.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670); main commentary [KR6i0343](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0343) (觀楞伽經記).
